name: Yu Na
source:
Yuna is a long-time friend and ex-girlfriend of [url=/c148291]MC[/url].
Self-destruction following the death of her [url=/c148423]mother[/url] and caring for her [url=/c148356]father[/url] took away many of her opportunities. But with a ‘chance encounter’ and her father’s wishes, it might not quite be the end of her story.
